title: Atlas Inspection Result v1
description: Structural schema for an AtlasInspection result — a GEOMETRIC FACT, never a jewelry-domain or manufacturing verdict. Forge (docs/bible/06-forge/) is the only layer permitted to interpret these facts as rule violations. See docs/bible/07-atlas/140-geometry-inspection-framework.md.

checkId.description: e.g. "FORGE-GEOM-001" for the one current runtime check, or a descriptive id for a test-only check.

component.description: Which component or assembly this fact concerns, e.g. "combined_metal".

message.description: A factual statement only, e.g. "1 solid detected" — never a phrase like "too thin" or "not manufacturable", which is Forge's vocabulary, not Atlas's.

runtimeOrTestOnly.description: CURRENT: exactly one check (the fuse-solid-count check backing FORGE-GEOM-001) is runtime; every other check in docs/bible/07-atlas/142-volume-and-bounding-box-inspection.md is test_only.
